name: wecom-autoreply
description: Opt-in, macOS: a resident WeCom (企业微信) AI bot whose replies are written by headless, tool-less Claude Code; requests that need you become numbered to-dos pushed to your WeCom, with an owner mode to list and close them. The owner can also send tasks that Claude Code runs with tools on the Mac; actions auto mode blocks wait for the owner's approval in WeCom. Includes wecom-cli setup and a launchd agent that keeps the long connection alive.
